name: Love Death 555! ~v-Realtime Lovers~
source:
Yuu has the ability to foresee the near future. He thinks it is more of a nightmare than a gift. His childhood friend Mizuno has bad luck and he has always saved her from accidents. One day, he saves her from dying in a traffic accident. In her place, someone else that they didn’t know passed away. A girl appears before them and tells her that she should’ve been the one to die. That’s when his bad luck began.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/11/04/november-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
悠拥有预见不久之后未来的能力。他认为这更像噩梦，而不是恩赐。他的青梅竹马水野运气很差，悠一直以来都在各种事故中救下她。某天，他使她免于死在交通事故中，代替她丧生的却是一个二人素不相识的人。随后，一名少女出现在他们面前，告诉水野，本该死去的人是她。从那一刻起，悠的厄运开始了。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/11/04/november-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
